name: secret-guard
description: Your shell holds the keys to production. secret-guard stops Claude Code from reading, printing or leaking them: it blocks risky commands and file reads, and redacts secrets from tool output before Claude sees them.

extra_paths.title: Extra credential paths
extra_paths.description: More files or folders to protect, like ~/.config/mytool or /etc/myapp/secrets. Commands and file tools that touch them are blocked.

extra_commands.title: Extra secret-printing commands
extra_commands.description: Regular expressions for more commands that print secrets, like \bmycli\s+secrets\s+show\b. Matching commands are blocked.
